articles.summary: Dr. Schlesinger has served as a member of Armata’s board of directors since February 2020. Dr. Schlesinger has served as a member of the Board of Directors of Innoviva, Inc. since 2018, and serves on its Compensation Committee and as chairperson of its Nominating/Corporate Governance Committee.
